text:
alex: Heads-up: vendor sent a maintenance alert — EU h100 pool capacity will be reduced by ~30% for a rolling firmware update starting 2024-09-15 01:00 UTC, lasting ~8 hours for the region. They said non-reserved ephemeral allocations may get throttled. Link: https://vendor.portal/maint/MT-2024-09-15
sophie: Oof. Does this impact our Dedicated/Demo reserved contracts or only on-demand spots?
vendor-bot: Maintenance affects on-demand and standby fallback instances in eu-west1 only. Dedicated/reserved reservations are honored. See note: customers with active reservations unaffected.
rahul: Ok — quick mitigation plan: 1) mark short-lived CI and tuning jobs with a lower scheduling weight; 2) move longer jobs to us-central or reserved pools; 3) run a canary change on one staging tenant. I can push a scheduler tweak:
```
# scheduler config snippet
scheduling_policy:
  project: proj-tuning-4
  weight: 10    # lower => deprioritize during congestion
```
emily: I can update the cron that launches nightly hyperparam sweeps to prefer us-central while the maintenance window is active. Which projects run the sweeps? I think proj-tuning-4 and proj-research-2.
alex: Correct. @rahul can you also add a feature-flag so we can flip back automatically after the window? Something short-lived like `eu_maintenance_20240915` toggled via flags service.
rahul: Yep. I'll open a small PR with the scheduler change + feature flag. PR: https://github.com/redwood/scheduler/pull/1982 (draft). Includes a migration to set weight=10 for proj-tuning-4 and proj-research-2.
sophie: Can we avoid a full deploy for the flag? Maybe the flags service supports overrides per-project — use that to avoid risk.
rahul: Good call. I'll use runtime override and then follow up with infra TF change to persist the lower weight.
emily: I'll run a one-off canary on proj-dev-1 tonight at 22:00 UTC and report if jobs get queued properly. If the canary looks good, schedule bulk changes at 23:00 UTC.
vendor-bot: FYI we can add up to 2 emergency protected projects for the window via support. Opened ticket #MT-333. ETA response ~1.5 hours.
alex: Thanks — if vendor can't protect both tuning projects, prioritize proj-research-2 for protection and move proj-tuning-4 to us-central. @emily please hold off on bulk until ticket resolved.
sophie: Also ping @oncall about potential alerts from autoscaler when jobs get deferred. We don't want noisy pagers during the firmware rollout.
rahul: I'll add a short-term autoscaler silence rule for the window. Patch is in the PR description.
emily: Noted. Will post canary results here.
alex: Perfect — appreciate fast turn. I'll update infra-ops and the SRE runbook with the mitigation steps.
